Why Power Quality Instrument - SICAM Q100?

SICAM Q100 is an advanced power quality measurement device. It monitors electrical parameters in single and multi-wire systems. Acquire, visualize, evaluate and transmit data like current, voltage, frequency, power and harmonics.
heading: Why Power Quality Instrument - SICAM Q100?

text: Poor power supply quality can impact your operations and safety and raise costs. SICAM Q100 captures and documents supply quality parameters so you can identify weak points and take action to stabilize operations. Expect verifiable data for compliance from IEC 61000-4-30 Class A power quality measurement. Integrated cybersecurity protects your sensitive data and system integrity. Use EN 50160 compliant reporting to take corrective actions.
